# Marieta du Plessis

> Professor of Leadership and Organisational Behaviour, Stellenbosch Business
> School, and Head of the Centre for Responsible Leadership Studies (Africa).
> Research focus: leadership, organisational behaviour, academic careers in
> higher education, workplace wellbeing, and workplace counselling.
